_note:
Cross-category caption donors for the Shuffled-Caption control (workshop paper).

Each of the 133 test prompts gets the cached Dream-Caption caption of a prompt from a
DIFFERENT category (category = the "(a Minecraft <category>)" suffix). Donors are
assigned greedily to spread reuse (medieval is 84/133, so a permutation cannot be
cross-category; donors repeat), ties broken by a hash, so the map is deterministic.
